options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: vmanage_endpoint
options.description: The IP address/endpoint of the Cisco Manager instance.

options.name: username
options.description:
Username to authenticate to the Cisco Manager instance.
This user should have the "Device monitoring" permission group.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate to the Cisco Manager instance.

options.name: namespace
options.description: Namespace can be used to disambiguate devices with the same IP.

options.name: max_attempts
options.description: Max number of retries to apply when polling Cisco Manager API.

options.name: max_pages
options.description: Max number of page to request when polling Cisco Manager API.

options.name: max_count
options.description:
Max number of resources to query per request when polling Cisco Manager API.
Maximum is 10000.

options.name: lookback_time_window_minutes
options.description: The time window to query when polling Cisco Manager metrics.

options.name: use_http
options.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS when polling Cisco Manager.

options.name: insecure
options.description: Skip server certificate verification when polling Cisco Manager.

options.name: ca_file
options.description: Use custom certificate authority when polling Cisco Manager.

options.name: collect_hardware_metrics
options.description: Enable collecting hardware metrics (CPU/Memory/Disk...).

options.name: collect_interface_metrics
options.description: Enable collecting interface metrics.

options.name: collect_tunnel_metrics
options.description: Enable collecting SD-WAN tunnel metrics.

options.name: collect_control_connection_metrics
options.description: Enable collecting control connections metrics.

options.name: collect_omp_peer_metrics
options.description: Enable collecting OMP Peer metrics.

options.name: collect_device_counters_metrics
options.description: Enable collecting device counters metrics (Crash/Reboot count).

options.name: collect_bfd_session_status
options.description:
Enable collecting BFD session status metrics.
Enabling this may significantly impact the check run duration, as well as adding load
on the Cisco Manager instance.

options.name: collect_hardware_status
options.description: Enable collecting hardware status metrics.

options.name: collect_cloud_applications_metrics
options.description: Enable collecting cloud application metrics (Latency/Loss/...).

options.name: collect_bgp_neighbor_states
options.description: Enable collecting BGP neighbor metrics.

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.

options.name: metric_patterns
options.description:
A mapping of metrics to include or exclude, with each entry being a regular expression.

Metrics defined in `exclude` will take precedence in case of overlap.
